topic: Mathar's recurrence in OEIS A386829, FORMULA 5, revisions 11–12 (2 November 2026), and related algebraic sequences
title: OEIS A386829, FORMULA 5, revisions 11–12 (2 November 2026): Mathar's recurrence and an algebraic family

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove the recurrence and D-finiteness conjectured by R. J. Mathar in OEIS A386829, FORMULA 5, revision 11 (2 November 2026), approved as revision 12. Its generating function is (7/sqrt(1-20z)-3)/(4+18z). A two-weight algebraic family proves the displayed recurrence conjectures in A386830 for n>=2 and A386831 for n>=4, and the exponential, reversion and hypergeometric identities in related entries. Coverage distinguishes written proofs, exact polynomial identities, finite coefficient checks and the pinned Lean declaration.
summary: Three Mathar recurrence conjectures, a two-weight algebraic family, and exact formula coverage for twelve OEIS entries, with polynomial certificates and finite coefficient checks.
